items.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
items.summary: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.

items.title: LifeVal
items.summary: Introducing LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.

items.title: Giving every team a data scientist with Grok Bot
items.summary: Data Bot is a Shared Bot in Grok Bot that the data science team teaches, so every team can query the warehouse, run analyses, and get answers the way a data scientist would.

items.title: Qodo builds context into AI code review with Codex
items.summary: Qodo brings company knowledge and coding standards into Codex, helping developers catch P0 issues across repositories before opening a pull request.

items.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions
items.summary: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups from around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.
